title: Outer Wilds
description: Explore a mysterious solar system trapped in an endless time loop. Every 22 minutes, the sun goes supernova and you wake up at the campfire until you uncover ancient cosmic secrets.

title: Journey
description: Glide through vast deserts toward a distant mountain. A wordless, stunning adventure that you can share with an anonymous stranger in the sand.

title: Stardew Valley
description: Inherit your grandfather's farm and build a new life in Pelican Town. Farm, fish, mine, and form friendships in this endlessly cozy farming RPG.

title: Hollow Knight
description: Descend into Hallownest, a vast underground kingdom of insects and fallen heroes. A challenging action-platformer with deep exploration and haunting atmosphere.

title: Rocket League
description: Soccer meets rocket-powered acrobatics in this fast-paced competitive sports sensation. Easy to learn, difficult to master.

title: Among Us
description: Complete tasks across a spaceship or eliminate crewmates as a disguised Impostor in this legendary party social deduction game.

title: Minecraft
description: Craft, mine, and build whatever you imagine, or embark on grand adventures through infinite procedural voxel biomes.

title: Celeste
description: Guide Madeline up Celeste Mountain through precision platforming trials while confronting inner doubts in a heartwarming story.

title: It Takes Two
description: Embark on an inventive, hilarious co-op adventure where two parents turned into dolls must solve wild challenges to reconnect.

title: Hades
description: Defy the god of the dead as Zagreus, hacking through Tartarus with legendary Olympian boons in this addictive rogue-like dungeon crawler.

title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
description: Create a cozy deserted island paradise. Fish, catch insects, build custom furniture, and chat with lovable animal neighbors at your own leisure.

title: LIMBO
description: Uncertain of his sister's fate, a young boy ventures into a sinister monochrome forest riddled with treacherous traps and eerie mysteries.

title: Forza Horizon 5
description: Experience vibrant open world landscapes across Mexico in the world's greatest cars with thrilling driving expeditions and competitive races.

title: Unpacking
description: A mindful zen puzzle game about the familiar experience of pulling possessions out of boxes and fitting them into rooms over a lifetime.

title: Overcooked! 2
description: Work together or scream at each other as chefs racing against time across chaotic kitchens on rafts, alien planets, and moving trucks.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description: Awake from a century-long slumber and traverse the boundless wilderness of Hyrule, scaling cliffs, solving shrines, and forging your own path.

title: Portal 2
description: Armed with an experimental portal device, solve ingenious physics puzzles and match wits with the brilliantly sarcastic AI GLaDOS.

title: Elden Ring
description: Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to brandish the power of the Elden Ring across the vast Lands Between in an epic fantasy world.

title: Super Mario Odyssey
description: Join Mario on a massive 3D globe-trotting sandbox adventure using his hat companion Cappy to capture and control objects, animals, and enemies.

title: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang are on the run across the rugged American heartland in an incredible tale of loyalty and conviction.

title: Cyberpunk 2077
description: An open-world action-adventure RPG set in Night City, a megalopolis obsessed with power, glamour, and relentless cybernetic body modification.

title: Terraria
description: Dig, fight, explore, and build! Nothing is impossible in this action-packed 2D adventure blending classic creativity with intense combat.

title: Genshin Impact
description: Step into Teyvat, a vast world teeming with life and elemental energy. Search for your lost sibling through stunning landscapes and dungeons.

title: Valorant
description: A 5v5 character-based tactical hero shooter where precise gunplay combines with unique agent abilities for unmatched competitive depth.

title: Apex Legends
description: Master an ever-growing roster of legendary characters with powerful abilities in a strategic fast-paced battle royale shooter.

title: Dead Cells
description: A rogue-lite, metroidvania action-platformer. You'll explore a sprawling, ever-changing castle with challenging 2D combat and zero checkpoints.

title: Slay the Spire
description: Fuse deckbuilding with rogue-like mechanics. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power.

title: Fall Guys
description: Dive and dodge through hilarious obstacle courses alongside dozens of chaotic jellybean competitors in a frantic party battle royale.

title: Subnautica
description: Descend into the depths of an alien underwater world filled with lush coral reefs, deep volcanic trenches, and terrifying leviathans.

title: Sea of Thieves
description: Sail together as pirates in an untamed shared open ocean. Hunt treasure, battle skeleton captains, and fire yourselves out of cannons.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: You are Geralt of Rivia, mercenary monster slayer. Track down Ciri, the Child of Prophecy, across a war-torn continent filled with dark secrets.

title: GRIS
description: A hopeful young girl lost in her own sorrow navigates an exquisitely hand-painted watercolor world using poetic abilities tied to grief.

title: Ori and the Blind Forest
description: A breathtaking action-platformer telling the emotional tale of a young orphan destined for heroics through lush, visually stunning hand-drawn art.

title: Cuphead
description: A classic run-and-gun action game heavily focused on boss battles, inspired by 1930s cartoons with authentic hand-drawn cel animations.

title: Dave the Diver
description: Catch fish by day in the ever-shifting Blue Hole, and serve delicious sushi by night in this charming, casual deep-sea adventure.

title: Baldur's Gate 3
description: Gather your party and return to the Forgotten Realms in an epic story of fellowship, betrayal, sacrifice, and the lure of absolute power.

title: Balatro
description: A poker-powered rogue-like deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger outrageous combos.

title: Helldivers 2
description: Join forces with up to three friends to spread Managed Democracy across the galaxy, blasting hordes of Terminids and Automatons in chaotic co-op.

title: Lethal Company
description: Scavenge scrap on abandoned moons to meet the Company's quota with friends while desperately avoiding horrifying night creatures.

title: Disco Elysium
description: A groundbreaking detective RPG where you wake up with total amnesia in a coastal district. Interrogate characters, solve murders, or take bribes.
